title: Re:SMP by ungleicher
description: The official Re:SMP Modpack used in ungleicher's videos.
body:
![Re:SMP Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bb68ba1718b797af77a0e54b0b1af6e8e3657631.png)
The Re:SMP Modpack is the official Modpack used in ungleicher's Re:SMP videos.

This Modpack is built around Create and includes many Create Addons like [Create Aeronautics](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-aeronautics) or [Create Railways Navigator](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-railways-navigator). It also includes many performance and quality-of-life mods. The goal of ungleicher is to build automated Create farms and a whole train system.

## What does this Modpack add?
This Modpack expands survival Minecraft with:
- The Create mod as the core gameplay element.
- A list of cool and useful Create Addons to help build at larger scale and with more depth.
- Performance and quality-of-life mods to enhance the vanilla gameplay.

## Why download this Modpack?
Download this Modpack if you want to play in the same style as ungleicher or the members of the Re:SMP server. You may especially enjoy it if you:
- Like to build giant train networks.
- Like to build automated Create farms.
- Love a smooth Create gameplay while not feeling overloaded by the amount of content added.

## Important information
This Modpack is intended for Minecraft 1.21.1 on NeoForge.

The Re:SMP Modpack is used and intended for ungleicher's Re:SMP series and the progression comes from ideas, just like in ungleicher's videos.
